name: SPECIMEN_OWNERS
description: The owners of a fertility embryo, oocyte, or sperm. These owners have the ability to make decisions about how the specimen will be used, and the specimens will appear in the owners' cryopreservation inventory.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the specimen record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: OWNERS_PAT_ID
columns.description: Stores the patients who own a given embryo, oocyte, or sperm. These patients are able to decide whether the specimen can be used for reproduction.

columns.name: OWNERS_NONPAT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Stores the people or entities (non-patient records) who own a given embryo, oocyte, or sperm. They are able to decide whether the specimens can be used for reproduction.

columns.name: OWNER_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments associated with the owner of the specimen

columns.name: OWNERS_LAB_ID_LAB_NAME
columns.description: The name of the lab record.
